conditioning: post-test descriptive diagnostics; thresholds fixed before this calculation; predictions and model selection unchanged
snr_definition: rho^2=4/(fs*N) sum_AE sum_k=1..N/2-1 |DFT(signal)|^2/PSD; same fixed finite-crop PSD and endpoints as main metric
bootstrap_scope: paired source bootstrap conditional on threshold and checkpoints; not training-seed uncertainty
inference_selection_scope: clean h and G*h available in simulation; observed-data selection needs an independently specified SNR estimator
